text.description_html:
AHI SIG122, Modern Block Door Lerver

The AHI made Block Leverset has a flat block style grip. The crisp, sharp edges add a unique accent to any home with a modern decor. The SIG122 Lever is solid stainless steel making it extremely resistant to corrosion, knocks, scratches, and abrasions. It will not degrade in appearance or function even after many years of use on your home or office. The pair is packaged with a spindle and the dummy is just the lever.

Also Available: AHI Sigma 122 -203 Lever with Square Rose.

Specifications of the SIG122 Modern Block Stainless Steel Lever:

  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Lever Length: 5.31" (135 mm)
  • Lever Width: 0.79" (20 mm)
  • Lever Thickness: 0.79" (20 mm)
  • Projection: 2.17" (55 mm)
  • Spindle Width: 0.31" (8 mm)

    • When Selecting a Function:

    • Single Dummy: For use as a door pull or to match trim. Trim is on one side of door.
    • Lever Pair: Comes packaged as a set of 2 levers and a spindle.

    Note: Single Dummy is Handed. All other functions are non-handed. Handing Guide
